description:
Rookie forward Justin Sourdif turned in a memorable January performance in his first season with the Washington Capitals, recording his first career hat trick as part of a five-point night against the Anaheim Ducks. After scoring twice in the opening period, Sourdif led a rush into the offensive zone in the second, moved the puck off his stick, and drove to the net, where a crisp passing sequence found him alone for a tap-in finish to complete the hat trick and help propel Washington to the win.

After retrieving the puck in the neutral zone, Montreal newcomer Zack Bolduc moves it over to Mike Matheson and regroups to turn up the ice. description:
Making his highly anticipated debut with the Minnesota Wild, Quinn Hughes wasted little time making an impact.  Just 54 seconds into the third period, Hughes joined the rush as the late trailer, positioning himself perfectly as the puck dropped back to him. Gathering the puck and taking a stride towards the net, he sent a wrist shot that slipped past the Boston Bruins netminder, igniting the home crowd.
